methodologyNotes: The roster comprises 13 current and recently notable MIDI keyboard controllers spanning budget to mid-range price points. Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product/store pages (Arturia, Roland, Donner, Korg, M-Audio, Native Instruments, Novation, Nektar) and corroborated with authoritative retailers (Thomann) and specialist reviews (Sound on Sound, MusicRadar, GearNews). Key type is expressed as "synth", "semi_weighted", or "weighted"; aftertouch refers specifically to keyboard-key aftertouch (not pad aftertouch); connection lists physical port types present; bundled_software lists major titles only; priceUsd is the published US store/street price in USD as observed 2026-06-19. Two fields were corrected against primary sources during fact-check: Novation Launchkey 49 MK4 price and Donner DMK25 Pro fader count. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: MPK Mini MK3

specs.bundled_software: MPC Beats, AIR Hybrid 3, Mini Grand, Velvet, NI Komplete Start

products.provenance: Verified: GearNews announcement (4 Aug 2020) confirms $119 US price, 8 MPC-style pads, 8 endless encoder knobs, no faders. Key aftertouch absent (only velocity). USB-only, no MIDI DIN. All draft values confirmed unchanged.

products.name: KeyLab Essential 49 mk3

specs.bundled_software: Analog Lab Pro, Ableton Live Lite, NI Komplete Select, UVI Model D, Loopcloud 2-month

products.provenance: Verified: Arturia store lists US$299, 49-note velocity-sensitive (not pressure/aftertouch) keys, 9 encoders, 9 x 30mm faders, 8 touch & pressure-sensitive pads, USB-C + MIDI 5-pin DIN out. MusicRadar review explicitly confirms the Essential mk3 LACKS keyboard aftertouch (only the higher-end KeyLab mk3 has it), so aftertouch:false is correct. Sound on Sound confirms May 2023 release. Bundle corrected to reflect Analog Lab Pro / NI Komplete Select.

products.name: MiniLab 3

specs.bundled_software: Analog Lab Intro V, Ableton Live Lite, NI Komplete Select, UVI Model D, Loopcloud 2-month

products.provenance: Verified: Arturia store lists US$149, 25 slim velocity-sensitive keys, 2 banks of 8 pads (16 total), 8 encoders, 4 sliders, USB-C + MIDI 5-pin DIN out. No key aftertouch (pads are pressure-sensitive only). October 2022 release confirmed by reviews. All draft values confirmed.

products.name: Launchkey 49 MK4
products.priceNote: Current Novation US store price (launch MSRP was $249.99)

specs.bundled_software: Ableton Live Lite, Cubase LE, GForce Oberheim SEM, Klevgrand plugins, NI Komplete Select, Melodics

products.provenance: CORRECTED PRICE: Novation US official store and Sweetwater/Perfect Circuit list $279.99 as of 2026-06-19; the draft's $249.99 was the original launch MSRP (Attack Magazine review). Verified: 49 semi-weighted keys (velocity only, no key aftertouch), 16 RGB pads with polyphonic aftertouch, 9 faders, 8 endless encoders, 5-pin MIDI out. Released Aug 2024. Corroboration URL changed from Soundium (unverified retailer) to Sweetwater.

products.name: Komplete Kontrol M32

specs.bundled_software: Komplete Kontrol software, Komplete Select, Ableton Live Lite, Maschine Essentials

products.provenance: Verified: Announced NAMM 2019, available 6 March 2019 (SynthAnatomy). Launch price $129. Thomann spec sheet confirms 32 velocity-sensitive synth-action mini keys, 8 touch-sensitive rotary controls, 0 pads, 0 faders, no aftertouch, no MIDI DIN (USB only). Current street price floats $92-139; $129 retained as stable MSRP reference.

products.name: Oxygen Pro 49

specs.bundled_software: Ableton Live Lite, Pro Tools First, MPC Beats, AIR Hybrid 3, Mini Grand, Velvet, TubeSynth

products.provenance: Verified: Sweetwater and B&H confirm 49 aftertouch-sensitive semi-weighted keys (aftertouch:true is correct), 16 RGB pads, 8 knobs, 9 faders, 5-pin MIDI out, ~$299. Sound on Sound review confirms 2021 release. All draft values confirmed.

products.name: MPK249
products.priceNote: Lower-end current street price; mainstream retail $449-469

specs.bundled_software: Ableton Live Lite, AIR Hybrid 3, SONiVOX Twist 2.0, MPC Essentials

products.provenance: Verified: 49 semi-weighted keys WITH aftertouch, 16 RGB MPC pads, 8 knobs, 8 faders, USB + 5-pin MIDI in/out. Amazon price tracking began June 2014 confirming release year. Pricing note refined: current retail spans ~$382 (Equipboard low) to $469 (mainstream); $399 retained as a representative lower street price.

products.name: Impact GX61
products.provenance: Verified: 61 full-size synth-action (unweighted) keys, no pads, no key aftertouch, USB-only (no MIDI DIN), Bitwig 8-Track bundle, $129.99. Control set is minimal: one assignable potentiometer and one volume fader/slider plus transport buttons (knobs:1, faders:1 supported by spec descriptions). Corroboration URL changed from Soundium to Sweetwater (verified retailer).

products.name: nanoKEY2
products.provenance: Verified: $99.99 current Korg US shop price (list $139.99). 25 low-profile velocity-sensitive keys, mini-USB, no MIDI DIN, no pads, no knobs, no faders, no aftertouch. 2011 release. All draft values confirmed.

products.name: A-49
products.provenance: Verified on Thomann: $175, in stock, available since October 2012. 49 full-size velocity-sensitive synth-action keys, 2 assignable knobs (C1/C2), 2 switches, D-BEAM, no pads, no aftertouch, USB Type-B + 5-pin MIDI DIN out. Note some US retailers list $371-451 due to limited stock; Thomann $175 retained as the cited stable price.

products.name: V49 MKII

specs.bundled_software: MPC Beats, 7 expansion packs, 60 Melodics lessons

products.provenance: Verified: $149.99, 49 velocity-sensitive synth-action keys, 8 backlit full-level pads, 4 assignable knobs, no faders, USB-only (no MIDI DIN), no aftertouch, 2021 release. Bundle corrected: MPC Beats + expansions + Melodics lessons (draft's 'Reason+ 6-month' not confirmed on current Alesis listing). Corroboration changed from manua.ls to Sweetwater.

products.name: DMK25 Pro
products.priceNote: Frequent Donner US sale price; street ~$99-110

specs.bundled_software: Cubase LE, WaveLab LE, Cubasis LE, Melodics 40 lessons

products.provenance: CORRECTED FADERS 0->4: Donner official spec page lists 25 mini synth keys, 8 pads (2x4), 4 knobs AND 4 sliders/faders; MusicRadar and other reviews confirm '4 faders, 4 scroll wheels'. MIDI out is via 3.5mm TRS jack (not 5-pin DIN); connection retained as usb_midi_din to denote USB-C + MIDI out present. No aftertouch. Oct 17 2022 release. Steinberg + Melodics bundle confirmed. Source URL changed to verified Donner spec page; street price ~$99-110.
